description: Jules Planning & Progress API for async coding tasks

novel_features.name: Quota-Aware Dispatch with Backoff
novel_features.description: Check quota before dispatching a session and retry with exponential backoff on 429/400 rate-limit errors, up to --max-retries (default 5).

novel_features.name: Pre-flight Conflict Detection
novel_features.description: Detect merge conflicts with in-flight sessions on the same repo before dispatching a new session, blocking creation unless overridden with --yes.

novel_features.name: Continuous Session Monitoring
novel_features.description: Poll one or more sessions for progress and state changes; --reconcile detects and reports stalled sessions with no activity for a configurable duration.

novel_features.name: Working Tree Checkpoints
novel_features.description: Save, list, and restore session state and activity snapshots locally, enabling safe mid-session work recovery after interruptions.

novel_features.name: Zombie Session Archival
novel_features.description: Identify sessions with no activity for a configurable duration (default 7 days) and archive them to free quota, with --dry-run to preview.

novel_features.name: Pre-submission Diff Validation
novel_features.description: Validate a session's diff isn't empty, isn't whitespace-only, stays within size limits, and has a meaningful commit message before submission.

novel_features.name: Workflow Trigger Chaining
novel_features.description: Chain cron schedules with GitHub workflow_run events to run Jules tasks on a schedule or automatically trigger workflows when sessions complete.

novel_features.name: Persona Memory Learning
novel_features.description: Record successful Jules task decomposition strategies and prompt patterns as reusable personas, backed by local SQLite persistence.

novel_features.name: Compliance & Safety Gating
novel_features.description: Check that Jules-generated changes comply with organizational policies (code review, security scanning, license, dependency, and API usage rules) before allowing submission.
